label: scam
source_name: Driver and Vehicle Licensing Agency, GOV.UK news 'DVLA releases latest scam images to help keep motorists safe online'
text:
Vehicle Tax Status - Unpaid!
Your bank has declined twice the latest Direct Debit payment.
If you will not Update your Information, your vehicle is no longer taxed.
NOTE: Our system will automatically retry the billing process once your billing details have been updated. It can take up to 5 working days for the records to update.
In order to continue to the payment page please use the following link.
Check Vehicle Status Now
ATTENTION: If you dont pay your vehicle tax on time you can be fined up to 1000 GBP
notes: DVLA vehicle-tax phishing email (image 'SCAM email - example 3'). Transcribed by hand from a screenshot published on the page and cross-checked against Windows OCR. Line breaks follow the screenshot where they separate fields; wrapped lines are joined.
